step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates Blackboard's multi-account AWS environment managed through AWS Control Tower. Based on the visual world model and audio transcript, AWS Control Tower orchestrates AWS Organizations for structuring organizational units (OUs) and leverages AWS Service Catalog to automate account creation and provision baseline configurations. The baseline provisioned services across accounts consist of AWS Single Sign-On (IAM) integrated with Okta, AWS Config for drift detection, AWS CloudTrail for centralized log aggregation, and IAM for role-based access control tied to single identities. Visual connections show Control Tower driving Organizations and Service Catalog, which in turn automate the deployment of the four baseline services. All text fields have been transcribed in English and node services mapped strictly to the valid vocabulary.
